Name: Noah, Daughter of Zelophehad
Summary: Noah, daughter of Zelophehad, was one of the five sisters who asked Moses for their father's inheritance.
KeyStory: Noah stood with her sisters before Moses and the congregation, and God granted daughters the right to inherit when there is no son.
RelatedPeople: Zelophehad; Mahlah; Hoglah; Milcah, Daughter of Zelophehad; Tirzah; Moses
LifeLesson: Five sisters standing together changed the law of inheritance.
